entries.19d57aac353f84aa: Construction and maintenance of telecommunications infrastructure
entries.1f8735174e690a3f: A general engineering company that started with the construction and maintenance of telecommunications infrastructure and now also handles urban infrastructure works and system construction for businesses.
entries.439f0f6722e4e3cb: The business builds and maintains various telecommunications infrastructure equipment nationwide for NTT Group and NCC (sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥255,693 million). Central to the business since its founding in 1954, it includes optical fiber line construction and capacity measures for mobile communications.
entries.455998b6f250995b: Construction and operation and maintenance management of water treatment and waste treatment plants, biomass boilers and similar facilities
entries.532f144f0fc73392: Various companies, including telecommunications carriers, financial companies and manufacturers
entries.6aac108480c44092: Educational and cultural sectors and local governments
entries.806c046420799c14: This business constructs and maintains telecommunications infrastructure for local governments, government agencies, CATV companies, railway companies and private companies, and also performs electrical and air-conditioning work for office buildings, condominiums, data centers and mega-solar facilities, urban civil engineering work such as undergrounding of utility lines and water and sewerage system development, and constructs and runs and maintains water treatment and waste treatment plants, biomass boilers and similar facilities (revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026: ¥248,455 million).
entries.92177277f1ab1c33: Design, Construction and Operation of Servers and LANs
entries.a77bf35952cfc591: The business provides system integration, including system construction and maintenance, and network integration, including design, construction and operation of servers and LANs, for various companies including telecommunications carriers, financial companies and manufacturers (sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥283,566 million). It also handles projects for educational and cultural sectors and local governments, and provides services in Japan and overseas.
